most_likely_explanation: An on-target, flat-bottomed, ~850-ppm, 4-5-h loss of light every 35.588 d from within ~1 arcsec of KIC 6448637 (K dwarf, G 15.7), consistent with a ~2.5-Re body on a b~0.3-0.6 orbit of the Gaia host; the alternative Kepler pixels cannot separate is an unresolved (<1-2 arcsec) faint eclipsing binary or an EB at 2P with equal eclipses. The pipeline's pixel-test failure (0/13 quarters) is a failure of that test on this TPF (Kp 8.75 saturated host with a 40-80-row bleed column; target in the bottom rows of the stamp, 1.7 px from the bleed column, psffrac 0.50): a localised re-analysis of the same TPF pixels finds a 3-7 e/s deficit at the target in 12 of 12 usable quarters, centroid dx = 0.00 +- 0.06, dy = +0.21 +- 0.07 px from the Gaia position, flat radial profile beyond 1.6 px, nothing on the G = 16.0 neighbour.
surviving_strengths: Pixel localisation on raw TPF pixels (independent of KBONUS): target-box deficit positive in all 12 quarters where the target is on the stamp (511-1228 ppm, 3-7 e/s); mean centroid offset dx=0.00+-0.06, dy=+0.21+-0.07 px (<0.9 arcsec); deficit complete within r<=1.6 px, 2.5-4.5 px annulus consistent with zero every quarter

Neighbours excluded by their own KBONUS light curves at the ephemeris: KIC 6448650 (G 16.0, 10 arcsec) -75+-121 ppm where >=1120 ppm would be required (~10 sigma); KIC 6448629 (G 18.4) 971+-694 ppm where 1.0% required (~13 sigma); TPF neighbour box shows no deficit; fainter Gaia sources (G 19.4-21.1 at 1.9-5.8 px) would need 2.4-12% eclipses 1.9-5.8 px from where the deficit sits

Shape: trapezoid chi2 grid with cadence integration gives box as best fit; pure V-shape disfavoured by delta chi2 = 24, T23/T14 >= ~0.55 at 2 sigma; secondary 3-sigma limit ~130 ppm at phase 0.5 and nothing at any phase

Depth consistent across seasons (857+-76, 857+-81, 728+-65, 853+-101 ppm) and across PSF vs SAP (0.96+-0.07 with crowdsap 0.94); no trend with the target's row position on the stamp; excluding bleed-column pixels does not change the deficit
Not a gap/edge artefact: only 2 of 24 events within 0.5 d of a gap (0.7 expected); depth 812 -> 794 ppm without them; inverted-flux null SDE 9.9 vs 50.6 real

Kepler-1715 b (KOI-308.01, Kp 12.35, P 35.5970 d) is on the SAME channel (ch 23/63 in seasons 0/2) but its period is 20 sigma from the 35.58777+-0.00045 d timing-fit period and its transits are 0.84-1.20 d away from ours at every epoch (min 0.835 d = 4.5 durations), so no ephemeris contamination; no other on-channel-and-on-time KOI/TCE/EB at P, P/2, P/3, P/4, 2P, 3P, 4P

Not known: absent from KOI cumulative, DR25 TCE, Kirk+2016 EB, confirmed planets (data/known, 2026-10-17), Bienias & Szabo 2025 (their 7 source apertures are other KICs), Moquin 2026 BOI-1; SIMBAD empty within 40 arcsec apart from the Kp 11 star at 30 arcsec; nearest KOI/EB is KIC 6448768 at 127 arcsec with unrelated 16.49-d period

Duration/density consistent with the Gaia host: T14 4.1-4.8 h at P 35.59 d implies rho*(b=0) 2.1-3.3 rhosun vs host 1.7-1.9 rhosun, i.e. b~0.3-0.6; Rp 2.4-2.5 Re undiluted; LS variability only 32 ppm at 0.74 d
